# Lavendar Lewis

## Overview

- **Age:** 45 (at the time of her wedding)  <sub>[v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v4 c3 P30](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Grafton  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045)</sub>; Mrs. Irving  <sub>[v3 c1 P2](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mother Lavendar  <sub>[v3 c23 P4](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0004), [v4 c3 P32](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0032)</sub>

## Appearance

She is a little lady with thick, beautifully wavy snow-white hair styled in becoming puffs and coils. Beneath her hair is an almost girlish face with pink cheeks, sweet lips, dimples, and big, soft brown eyes. She favors dainty frilled organdy and muslin dresses with laces.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c28 P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018)_

## Personality

She is an imaginative, romantic, and warm-hearted woman who maintains the youthfulness of her heart. Despite a lonely life, she is generally a happy and contented person who enjoys life's simple pleasures, tea parties, and play-pretend. By her own admission, she can be sulky and proud when hurt. She is deeply hospitable and forms strong, affectionate friendships.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)_

## Goals

- To maintain her romantic dream world and joy in life despite past heartbreak  <sub>[v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>

## History

After her mother died, Lavendar lived at Echo Lodge in Grafton and hired Charlotta Bowman to stay with her for board and clothes, continuing to hire her sisters under the name Charlotta. Anne Shirley and Diana Barry discovered her secluded home and established a close friendship with her, joining in her imaginative tea parties and cozy gatherings. When Anne introduced Stephen Irving's young son Paul to her, Paul wrote to his father about her, prompting Stephen to return to Grafton after twenty-five years. Stephen and Lavendar reconciled their past misunderstandings, rekindled their romance, and were married in her honeysuckle arbor at Echo Lodge. Following their wedding, they moved west to the Pacific coast. Years later, she returned with Stephen and Paul to visit Echo Lodge and her friends in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c29 P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 c30 P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 c30 P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v3 c1 P2](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0002), [v4 c3 P30](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0030)_

## Background by volume

- Named Lavendar by her father because he loved the scent  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- Engaged to Stephen Irving twenty-five years ago before a foolish quarrel separated them  <sub>[v2 c21 P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>
- Took in a succession of young girls named Charlotta for board and clothes after her mother died  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Lived a quiet, secluded life at Echo Lodge in Grafton  <sub>[v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

## Quotes

> But what is the use of being an independent old maid if you can’t be silly when you want to, and when it doesn’t hurt anybody?  <sub>[v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)</sub>

> I’m really a very happy, contented little person in spite of my broken heart.  <sub>[v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>

> I knew I would rather be an old maid for a thousand years than marry anybody who wasn’t Stephen Irving.  <sub>[v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>

> Oh, sometimes, I think it is of no use to make friends. They only go out of your life after awhile and leave a hurt that is worse than the emptiness before they came.  <sub>[v2 c27 P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032)</sub>
